label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: The yellow sofa, left pillow, dark coffee table, two tea settings, flower pot, pale wall and right curtain clearly reconstruct the intended setting.
The table remains in front of the sofa, with flowers between the cups, a pillow at left and curtain behind the right end. The main spatial identity is preserved.
Furniture and tabletop objects retain broadly compatible relative sizes. The sofa is noticeably shallow and its base tall, but the arrangement remains a plausible simplified reconstruction.
Warm yellow upholstery, dark table and pot, white cups, green foliage and gray curtain preserve the main color contrasts. Shapes and surfaces are substantially simplified.

The author view is clearly illuminated with coherent shading and visible contents. Lighting is flatter and less directional than the reference, but preserves a bright indoor atmosphere. The blank evaluator view does not invalidate this.
The complementary side view shows sofa depth, tabletop depth and cylindrical cup and pot volumes with changed occlusion, establishing genuine three-dimensional representation.

Actual mesh records locate sofa, table, cups and pot through parent chains. Box.024, Box.037, Rod.085, Rod.092 and Rod.098 have finite nonempty meshes and assigned materials with connected shader outputs; these are editable geometry rather than empty declarations.

dimension_scores.evidence: The subject and main arrangement correspond clearly, while rigid upholstery, sparse flowers and angular curtains lose much of the reference character.
Furniture and tabletop items appear supported without major visible floating. Cups have flat, filled-looking tops, and the rigid pillow lacks convincing fabric compression.
The main palette is preserved, but upholstery is paler and blockier; curtains resemble straight strips rather than flowing cloth.
Primitive forms, mechanically arranged foliage, flat cup interiors and visible render noise limit believability despite consistent object recognition.
The front/back and left/right relationships are closely retained, including the right-offset table and central flowers. The composition is more frontal and regular.
Table, cups and pot have reasonable relative sizes, but the sofa has a tall base and unusually shallow seating; the flower arrangement is narrower than the target.
Illumination is readable and shadows coherent, but the reference's side-lit warmth and surface variation are weakly reproduced. Upholstery, wood and carpet lack distinct texture.
All major furnishings and both tea settings are present, together with the wall, floor and right curtain. The bright window-edge treatment and smaller surface details are missing or simplified.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
